name: rabble-aether
description: RaBbLE-Aether — unified design system and visual identity for the Collective

scripts.build:min: npx esbuild src/entry.css --bundle --minify --outfile=dist/aether.min.css --sourcemap=linked --banner:css="/*! Aether $npm_package_version+$(git rev-parse --short HEAD 2>/dev/null || echo nogit) */"
scripts.build:dev: npx esbuild src/entry.css --bundle --outfile=dist/aether.css --sourcemap --banner:css="/*! Aether $npm_package_version+$(git rev-parse --short HEAD 2>/dev/null || echo nogit) */"
scripts.cast: npm run build && cp dist/aether.min.css dist/aether.min.css.map ../RaBbLE-World/aether/v0.0.0.0/ && cp dist/aether.css dist/aether.css.map ../RaBbLE-World/aether/v0.0.0.0/
scripts.build:versioned: VERSION=${npm_config_version:-v$npm_package_version} && npm run build:dev && npm run build && mkdir -p dist/$VERSION && cp dist/aether.css dist/aether.css.map dist/aether.min.css dist/aether.min.css.map dist/$VERSION/ 2>/dev/null; echo "Built → dist/$VERSION/"
